baseline.description: Pre-change read-only profiler binary retained before popup projection implementation. Backend source was unmodified at turn start. Existing spinner/diagnostic changes remain in the worktree.

omittedColumns.scope: Stored JSON column bytes for the same owner on the immutable backup; not HTTP size or decoded memory.

scope.json: Original json_encode_for_html filter wall time and escaped output UTF-8 bytes, static section names in validated call order; a subset of renderMs, never add to renderMs.
scope.render: Empty-output functions immediately before/after production template nodes; includes JSON filters and template output construction, excludes mutex waiting and Tera setup before the first node.

notes: Production-built real PC/mobile AnswerMapModal, map/filter/color/print modules; benchmark-only expose/runtime captures are injected at build time.
Uses real read-only Rust map, map-filter and map-print HTTP endpoints through a localhost proxy. Original 1MiB request cap is retained.
External requests are blocked; tiles/icons/media are local placeholders. Network tile latency and real authentication are excluded.
Raw HTML/geometry/answer contents remain local; reports contain only aggregate counts, timings and byte sizes.
PC 1280x800; mobile 390x844 with CPU4x emulation, not a physical mobile device. The real fixture contains shapes, not a large marker population.
The ordinary parent editing map and Pinia raw-record store are not mounted concurrently. This does not guarantee whole-application or physical-device memory usage.
Logical visible targets are independent from generated Leaflet objects and SVG DOM counts; all are reported separately.
Operation timings include endpoint work, HTTP/JSON, Vue, iframe rendering and settling plus automation coordination. Do not add them to backend-only measurements.
Heap values are Chrome JS heap after forced GC, not full browser/process memory. Long tasks may be observed by both same-process frame contexts.
Full print may be normally rejected by the retained 32MiB byte cap; successful bounded print uses an actual legend mask of at most1000 targets.

With --initial-only=true, each sample still performs real native map and automatic initial options requests, waits for the combined UI/shape readiness criterion, then verifies collection after closing; full interaction phases are skipped only in that diagnostic mode.

Each sample uses a fresh context/page. There is no unrecorded warmup. First and subsequent samples share the same Chrome browser and already-started backend/OS caches; cold storage/DB caches are not simulated. Contexts isolate browser HTTP caches, and proxy API/assets are no-store.

Native initial response is fully buffered by the diagnostic proxy, decoded, rewritten and encoded before forwarding. Proxy upstream-header/body/decode/rewrite/encode/send times are recorded separately; they are diagnostic overhead, not application backend time. Response-send completion is a Node socket callback, not browser responseEnd.

Bootstrap is a JavaScript object literal in an inline script, not JSON.parse. Marks are in separate scripts before/after it so the span includes parser/compile/evaluation and may overlap remaining HTML transfer/parser waiting. It is not pure JavaScript CPU time.

parent.mapReady.receive / parent.loading.cleared are the application's ready signal and do not wait for renderer idle; actual receive/idle ordering is shown by the milestones. Automatic options complete later. Paint-opportunity marks are double-rAF scheduling boundaries, not proof that every object pixel was painted.

initial ms preserves the existing combined benchmark criterion: parent scope/options/color-fieldset readiness plus renderer idle and frame settling. Nested spans overlap and must not be added together. CDP duration deltas are renderer/target aggregates and include automation overhead; they are not exact exclusive attribution of iframe JavaScript parsing.

Spinner probes inspect only the fixed loading message, inline/visible booleans and CSS animation properties. Reduced motion is explicitly no-preference for this UI check; normal application reduced-motion behavior is unchanged.

scope: Every expected bootstrap section is compared; missing, duplicate or unexpected sections fail closed.
JSON is decoded without eval. Object keys are sorted at every depth; all array order and full strings are retained.
Integers use arbitrary precision and fractional numbers use Decimal, never binary floating-point rounding. Numeric representation changes can conservatively produce a mismatch.
Only answerPreview.query.as_of is excluded; query conditions, target array order, counts, transport metadata, geometry, popup text and shape/marker text are compared.
canonicalBytes measures ASCII-escaped canonical data, not HTTP size. SectionDigestSha256 hashes the sorted section-name/digest mapping, not the original HTML.
Different process-start as_of values are allowed only for this immutable-copy output comparison. Equal resulting data does not prove identical query cutoffs.
Reports contain aggregate counts/bytes, static section names, booleans and whole-section hashes only. No data IDs, text, coordinates or URLs are emitted.

conditions.native: Release real Rust/SQLx handler, preliminary standalone load plus one handler warmup followed by three measured sequential handler calls per binary. Original full-column binary retained before implementation.
conditions.nativeAsOf: Each CLI process creates its own as_of timestamp. All answers in the immutable backup are older than both cutoffs; answer/target counts and all11bootstrap sections match except that metadata timestamp. This is not a cold OS/database startup comparison.
conditions.browser: Production-built real PC/mobile AnswerMapModal and map modules; three fresh contexts/pages per mode per stage. Both stages use the before manifest so query/as_of/form/conditions and expected counts are identical.
conditions.functional: After only, PC/mobile one full workflow each, one close/collection check per workflow. Used for correctness, not a before/after performance claim.
conditions.externalTilesIconsImages: Local placeholders; real external tile latency and real authentication excluded.
conditions.cache: Same already-started backend/OS/Chrome processes reused within a stage. Browser HTTP contexts fresh. Storage/OS caches not reset.
conditions.proxy: Fully buffers, UTF-8 decodes/rewrites/encodes HTML before forwarding; per-stage overhead recorded and included in browser workflow, excluded from server-timing handler.
conditions.timing: Loading-cleared is Vue ref update, not GPU paint. Combined ready includes automatic options, shape idle and frame settling. SQLx observed durations include fetch and possible row decoding, not pure database time. Nested spans/independent medians must not be summed.
conditions.setupMetric: The single preliminary standalone load was2264.96ms before/4268.50ms after. It is retained as setup information, is not a repeated cold-start measurement, and is not used to claim improvement.

unchangedContracts: Complete editing Answer type, document/answer SQL, revision/edited_at/token behavior.
Popup owner join, initial authorized target IDs, all target answer history regardless of list conditions/as_of, timestamp/ID order, same read transaction and at most4bounded queries.
Existing stored parts and unambiguous legacy adoption, duplicate/empty/overlap handling, free_text/managed_markdown/sync_required.
Full geometry and popup payload; no frontend product change, no extra per-object GET, no cache or DB schema change.

sqliteRust.environmentNote: Initial restricted-network run stopped in4existing localhost HTTP tests. Same full suite passed in host environment with no source changes.

checks.print: Full real snapshot exceeds32MiB and is rejected. Actual legend-masked1000targets all rendered with pending0; placeholder resources exercise the existing30s fallback, so this is not a normal resource-completion timing.

limitations: Real SQLite data only; PostgreSQL behavior verified with temporary-database tests, not a real PostgreSQL performance run.
Mobile is CPU4x Chrome emulation, not a physical device. Parent editing map/Pinia are absent; no whole-app or full-process memory/GPU guarantee.
Initial generated shapes83 versus19776logical targets. Real fixture has no markers; marker correctness covered by regression tests.
Native startup HTML differs by3bytes from generated as_of spelling only. Shapes44040907bytes and popupBodies27645776bytes are unchanged. Browser literal parsing and roughly72.6MB HTML remain.
Three-sample medians are diagnostic, not a guaranteed improvement rate or a real-time CI threshold.

reproduction.native: Run retained before profiler and rebuilt after profiler with --database target/PRIVATE_COPY.sqlite --output-directory target/PRIVATE_STAGE --initial-samples 3 --serve --port 0; loopback/Origin protections retained.
reproduction.browser: Use measure-answer-map.mjs --initial-only=true --samples=3 with each backend URL and the same before manifest for both. Stop builds/tests first. Run Chrome and both servers in the same host execution environment.
reproduction.functional: Use rebuilt backend and same before manifest, --samples=1 --cycles=1, default pc,mobile modes; omit --initial-only.
